reviews.text:
Anyone who owns exotic pets knows that, sooner or later, they'll need to take them to the vet.

In our case, we took our little rats there, and I only have words of gratitude for the entire team for their honesty and the excellent work they always do.

Their endless patience and dedication are truly remarkable.

A special thank you to Javi, who has become our little ones' go-to vet.
Specializing in exotic animals, they are empathetic and very affectionate with our pets.

TOTAL DISAPPOINTMENT.

As a customer for four years, I had an appointment at 6:30 PM to vaccinate my rabbit. I left home at 5:00 PM and traveled 120 km from Castilla-La Mancha. To my surprise, upon arrival, they wouldn't see me because I arrived at 6:40 PM. With the entire afternoon ahead of me, a three-minute injection, and I had to return at 8:00 PM. After a three-hour journey that stresses rabbits, and with each day she goes unvaccinated delaying her Econiculi fluid, I found it appalling. Other times you arrive on time and they're with other animals, and you can wait 50 minutes, and nothing happens. Anyone with a little knowledge knows what it's like entering Valencia through Catarroja and the port, but apparently, the DANA storm took the heart out of, let's call them, these professionals. My recommendation to people from outside is not to go if you don't want to be treated in such an unfair way. The worst part isn't the trip or the parking, but that my pet still hasn't had its vaccine because some irresponsible people don't want to work.

Our visit to this vet was outrageous. We took our lovebird to this clinic worried about a limp in its leg. They took a stool sample and recommended an X-ray to check for internal damage. They told us it was a hormonal problem and that three injections would improve it (without mentioning any possible complications of the treatment, but emphasizing that if we didn't proceed, the bird would obviously get worse), so we decided to start. The first injection went well; it showed some improvement. By the time it received the second injection on a Thursday, it only worsened. We kept an eye on it, and within three days, it stopped chirping, eating, and flying, and began having motor and even respiratory difficulties. Given the severity of the situation, we took it to the emergency vet on Saturday. They wanted to charge us €90 for the emergency visit plus any tests they needed to perform, but we decided to wait and give it anti-inflammatories because they couldn't guarantee a clear diagnosis. On Monday, we had to take the poor animal in a deplorable state, and the only solution they offered was to euthanize him (they give you several options, each more expensive than the last, doubling the price, even if you want to cremate him and take the urn with the ashes). We left the clinic without knowing what had happened to him, and he never came home. And finally, as if that weren't enough, they called us two weeks later to come back to the clinic for his third injection, implying that they hadn't even removed him from the system.
The trusted veterinarian for our small rodents
I took my lovebirds there... they received excellent care. A very good exotic animal veterinarian.

I don't usually leave reviews because I think it's pointless, but today I believe it's important to share my experience to help improve the service:

A week ago, I called in desperation because my pet was dying after an accident. The emergency vet initially acted correctly, but given my family's state of shock, we were hesitant to take him to the clinic due to the distance and the animal's condition. Eventually, she changed her tone and rudely told me not to bother her about whether or not we should come for "20 minutes," as her workday ended at 9 pm. I was absolutely stunned.

I hope management or whoever is responsible will address this issue. Being a veterinarian isn't just about caring for animals; it's also about empathizing with people.
Excellent treatment and service. Loli has recovered and is now perfectly fine after her check-up. A perfect ten.

A month ago, I went to Clínica Nido with my Russian hamster, Pan, looking for a clinic in Valencia that treated exotic animals and whose main veterinarian wasn't on vacation. You wouldn't believe how lucky I was to find them.

We took Pan in because we noticed a lump on his chin. From the very first moment, both the veterinarian, Elisabet, and the assistant, Miguel, were incredibly attentive.

But especially Elisabet, who was the most involved in our case, was incredibly helpful. She explained everything to us, every option Pan had, gave us the medication, and explained all the instructions.

When it came time for the surgery, they were incredibly flexible with us since we live far from the center of Valencia. They stayed with Pan overnight and took exceptional care of him. They even made room for us so Pan wouldn't suffer any longer and could have his surgery as soon as possible.

Finally, what seemed like just a pus-filled abscess was actually a small tumor that couldn't be removed because it was located near his jaw.

We did everything we could for him, and I'm so grateful that thanks to the clinic I was able to spend a little more time with Pan. The good thing is that we never saw him lose his energy; he simply fell asleep in his little house and went to the land of rainbows 🌈.

Thank you for your concern and for calling me when I had to cancel the appointment due to his passing. Thank you for doing everything possible and always thinking of what was best for him.

And sorry for the long message, but having such professionals has truly made this whole process so much easier to bear.

Two operations on two rats, one with a very advanced lump and everything went perfectly with both, although there wasn't much hope for the second one, in the end everything went very well. Even knowing it was unlikely, we took the risk, and it was worth it because Ruby was full of life and very playful. Thank you for everything.

I took my hen Ramona in yesterday because of a problem with her egg production, and they treated me wonderfully from beginning to end. They were very friendly, helpful, and clearly passionate about animals. I highly recommend them.

Absolutely degrading treatment, a terrible experience that I can't understand how the owner of the center can allow. I traveled for an hour, it took me 20 minutes to park, and because I was 20 minutes late, they told me they couldn't see me because there was no space. What? If I had been on time, I would have had to wait because they were full, but they treat someone who arrives with a parrot after an hour's drive with their car in such an inhumane way. A complete lack of empathy from the young man who served me, who even had the nerve to ask me for an appointment for another day. The thing is, I was parked badly and with the parrot in the car; otherwise, I would have explained it to him clearly. There's a saying that goes, "What goes around comes around."
My daughter goes there quite often and loves it. I can't add much more.

Last week we took our canary Luna to the vet because she had an egg stuck (it was very large). She was admitted to try to induce her to lay it naturally, but she couldn't.
The vets then tried to remove it while sedating Luna, but they couldn't; it was broken and could infect the rest of her body.
Finally, the only option was surgery to remove the egg. We knew it was very complicated, and if it wasn't done, Luna would die.
She was hospitalized the whole time and received injected antibiotics.
The surgery was a complete success. Now Luna is doing very well and living a normal life. I've already put her with her canary and followed the dietary recommendations that Eli gave me.
There are no words to thank the whole team for their great professionalism and dedication. Thank you, thank you, thank you for saving Luna.
I 100% recommend Clínica Nido for the care of your pets. 👌🐥😻

They quickly agreed to see my hamster Valya! They performed surgery to clear his eye and gave him antibiotics. He's back in a week! I want to see the parrot who was screaming all the time in the hospital! 🥰🤩⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

A special thank you to veterinarian Elizabeth for the dedication and professionalism she has shown with Maximus.

Thank you for your proactivity and patience. From the very first moment, she explained each step to us and took the time to answer all our questions.
I would also like to highlight her honesty. She explained the different possibilities and the risks of each option at all times, without creating false expectations, but always seeking the best alternative for our rabbit. It's clear that she truly cares about the well-being of animals and that she works with love and responsibility.
Thank you so much, Elizabeth, for taking such good care of him ❤️🐰
Very professional!!!

The veterinarian who saw us today was unpleasant from the start, treating us in a way that made us feel judged without knowing the situation.

She told us her pet was very ill and there wasn't much that could be done, which we understand, but the way she communicated this was very insensitive and made assumptions about decisions we hadn't made.

When we decided to take her home, her attitude was arrogant. When we asked about payment, she responded curtly.

We left very disappointed with the treatment we received.
Excellent service from Nelo on the two occasions I've had to go there for "emergency" reasons.

I've spent a lot of time at this clinic over the months and have witnessed firsthand the care I received from the staff. I can only say that if you have a pet, don't hesitate to take them to this clinic. A couple of months ago, I lost my rabbit, Tambor. Eli and I had been fighting for months, hoping he would get better and better, but in the end, it wasn't to be. I'm writing this because I want to emphasize the care I received weekly from each member of the team—Ali, Noe, Miguel, and so on—but especially from Eli, who couldn't have done a better job, and her personal touch was exceptional. I'd also like to highlight the peace of mind I felt every time I left Tambor there. I knew they loved him very much and that he was in good hands, so you really shouldn't hesitate to trust them. And to the team, my heartfelt congratulations, and please know that I remember you all very fondly. You are an example to follow, and as a veterinary student, I admire you.
They took care of my hamster, sadly it didn't survive, but they were always willing to help and provide the best care.

We took my rabbit Tambor to the emergency vet at night from Castellón and they were wonderful. They tried everything they could to save him, but in the end, it wasn't possible and he passed away. They treated us incredibly well, understanding our pain, and let us see him and be with him without rushing. Honestly, for me, they're a 10 out of 10, both as a clinic and as people. Thank you!
I'm very grateful to the whole team. They were incredibly kind and professional. I highly recommend them for any questions about exotic animals.

I live in Alicante and traveled with my rooster, who had a leg deformity that prevented him from walking. The vet operated on him, but it didn't go well; I don't blame him for that, as it was one of the possibilities. He told us to contact him again in a couple of months because further procedures could be performed to help him. I did so: I sent emails and made calls trying to reach him, but he never returned my calls or answered any emails. It's been months since my last attempt to contact him. Until today, my rooster, Pollito, lived at home with us, and we did everything we could for him. Unfortunately, this morning I went to his room to wake him up, and he had passed away. We lived with him for a year and a half as one of the family. I find it incredibly unprofessional and completely lacking in empathy that the Nido clinic neglected the case like this. If nothing more could be done for him, the right thing to do would have been to tell me clearly. I do not recommend this clinic to anyone. They have shown me a great lack of interest in the well-being and follow-up of the animal after surgery.
Excellent service, very friendly and perfect care for my pets. Very professional. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. Very happy with the service I received. Cheers!

Last night, this clinic answered a phone call from Castellón regarding an emergency with our pet. The staff were incredibly helpful and professional, assisting us in every way possible.

A highly recommended place to entrust your pets' health.

Excellent service, 100% recommended. We took our rabbit Rubio in for gastric arrest, and Nelo attended to him immediately. He was hospitalized for several days until he was completely recovered, and we picked him up yesterday. Nelo, Noelia, and Javier kept us promptly informed of his progress. The veterinary team was incredibly well-coordinated, and the service was outstanding. The final reports were very comprehensive, and they performed all the necessary diagnostic tests. The medical team is highly professional and, above all, wonderful people. Keep up the great work, everyone! Our pets are part of the family, and we fight for them 100%.
I don't recommend it.

Talent and love. We've had several mishaps with our guinea pigs, and everything has turned out fine thanks to their care.
Even though we always have to travel the 70km that separate us, we'll always come back.
They did everything they could to save our sick parakeet and were very attentive to us. We are so grateful <3 <3 <3

Eternal thanks, guys, for taking care of Nata and believing in him until the very end. We felt supported, and you are all excellent professionals and people, from the first to the last. Javi, a big hug; we couldn't see you, but your colleague was wonderful company in this final moment. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. A parakeet flying towards a cloud sends you a kiss.
Good veterinarians, specialists in exotic animals.
They treat pets well and do everything they can for them.

Very professional, excellent service.
Thank you for your attention to Chikitin...
Our rabbit had a virus and we decided to put him to sleep. The clinic was good and clean, but the parrot's screams were terrifying.

Excellent professionals. I've taken several pets to them on different occasions, and they've always been very efficient. They're not only good veterinarians, but they're also very caring with animals. Without a doubt, the best experience I've had in terms of diagnosis and treatment.

Completely unprofessional. I don't know how they treat animals, but wow... They gave me an appointment over the phone at 11:00 AM, and when I arrived they told me it was at 10:30 AM, which is impossible because I can't make it at that time. They weren't able to help me even after I told them it was an emergency and that I had a pre-arranged appointment. An hour wasted, but with that kind of customer service, I don't even want to know how they treat animals.

I'm very happy with the care my dear Mochi received. They looked after her every step of the way and explained everything honestly and with empathy. If I ever get another exotic pet, I'll definitely go back to Nido.
Fortunately, there are other clinics.

I want to thank the whole team, especially Javi, who looked after us one day, and above all Noelia, for being so kind and caring with my little Navi during all our visits. It's been two months of ups and downs; we've all done what we could, and now my little angel is resting, but she received the best care we could give her.

Thank you, Noelia, for doing everything possible and especially for knowing when to stop to avoid causing her any suffering.

Hugs,
Teresa

"Life is too short not to enjoy it swinging on a swing."

—Navi, the cutest albino lovebird—
Excellent customer service
Our pet is very sick. The clinic staff treated us very well; everyone is very kind and trustworthy. They are excellent professionals.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Xavier and the entire clinic team.

We recently found out that our rat had a tumor, and naturally, we were very worried. As soon as we called the clinic, we were given an appointment right away. From the very first visit, Dr. Xavier treated our rat with incredible care and gentleness he examined her thoroughly, handled her very delicately, and even comforted her by gently petting her.

He recommended surgery, and although I was extremely nervous at first, with each visit my anxiety decreased. It became clear that Dr. Xavier is a true professional who genuinely cares about his patients.

After the surgery, when we came to pick her up, Dr. Xavier explained everything in detail. He also told us that they had discovered and successfully removed a second, smaller tumor during the operation. He gave us clear instructions on how to care for her and scheduled a follow-up visit in five days.

Today we had that check-up, and we were so happy to hear that everything is healing perfectly. Honestly, the stitches are almost invisible the work was done incredibly professionally.

Dr. Xavier is also a very kind and humble person, and the staff at the clinic are friendly and welcoming. I also have to mention his rat tattoo it truly touched my heart ❤️

Thank you so much for your high-quality work and dedication. I am beyond grateful and would highly recommend this clinic. The prices are also very reasonable.

We would like to thank Noelia for her great professionalism, empathy, and dedication to the animals' health.

Since January, we had been taking our Syrian hamster to the clinic for a rather complicated neurological condition that had no medical solution. Noelia gave us guidelines for palliative care, prescribed medication to alleviate Hams' pain, and helped us be with him until the very end.

Sadly, Hams passed away last week, but he went to heaven peacefully.

Noelia did everything she could so that he could spend his last month of life with us, enjoying his final days. Thank you so much for your wonderful work! 💚

Two weeks ago, we took our Syrian hamster, Pikachu, to the vet because he had become very lethargic and seemed unwell. From the very first moment, Noe took care of us, and we couldn't be more grateful. They admitted him and discovered a mass that ultimately turned out to be a tumor.

It has been a very difficult few days for us, but Noe was with us every step of the way with incredible professionalism and compassion. She explained each step with great patience, clarity, and empathy, answering all our questions and treating us with immense kindness. You can tell when someone loves their work and truly cares about their patients and their families.

Ultimately, the tumor grew significantly, Pikachu began to limp and tremble, and there was nothing more that could be done. So, we had to make the difficult decision to euthanize him for his well-being and to prevent further suffering. It was a very sad moment, but we felt supported and understood throughout.

We also want to thank Laura, who saw us on the second day, because she was equally kind and professional.

A heartfelt thank you to Noe for his outstanding work and for his incredibly respectful care. Pikachu was so small, but he left a huge mark on us, and we will always be grateful for the love and care he received until the very end. I highly recommend this exotic animal veterinarian.

I am SO grateful to the entire team.
They were honest about all the diagnoses and options available, they didn't ask us to do pointless tests just to make money, and they tried to make our Tipi as happy as possible until the day we had to say goodbye. Without a doubt, if any of my other exotic companions gets sick, I would go back to them first.

I'll summarize as much as possible: my bunny was suffering from swelling under his eye and discharge from both his eye and nose. After the treatment we received at another veterinary clinic, where they implied I would lose my bunny and after blindly performing surgery under his eye because they didn't know what was wrong, I decided to seek help from professionals who know how to provide proper care. I contacted Clínica Nido urgently, and they gave me an appointment right away. Upon arriving at the clinic, the staff was kind and empathetic, explaining everything thoroughly and reassuringly. I left Bolita with them for a few days for observation until they could run tests to determine what was wrong. I received calls throughout this time updating me on Bolita's condition. Once the tests were completed, they informed me about his broken teeth and the fissure in his nasal passage, which were the possible causes of the swelling and discharge. A few days later, they performed the difficult surgery to extract several molars and repair the fissure. The operation was successful, and his recovery was very quick. All that's left for me to do is thank these wonderful people for the way they treated us and for helping my bunny after the hell we went through.
Even though I live a bit far from Valencia, I'll never go to any other clinic but Nido again!

We live far away, and I brought my bunny along because where I live I don't have the good fortune of having good exotic animal vets. Eli treated me, and I have to say she's a sweetheart. She knows how to treat both animals and people. They're very professional, and they successfully performed a CT scan, being very considerate of me and my bunny's condition at all times. Without a doubt, this is my new go-to clinic. Thanks, guys!

Besides being excellent professionals, they are all lovely, from the initial phone call to the consultation. They operated on my hamster to remove a tumor, and everything went perfectly. He had a minor issue with the stitches, which they resolved very quickly. They are very fair with their estimates and fees, and completely transparent. I think it's one of the best clinics you can find right now.
We took our African Grey parrot Lola because she hurt one of her nails and it was bleeding, and the treatment has been special, we are very happy.
Thanks to the whole team, especially Nelo, Perica is back to her old self and a champion again.

A TERRIBLE experience. I had a guinea pig named Wendy. I took her in for surgery to remove ovarian cysts. Two days before the surgery, she stopped eating. When I went in, I told the vet, Noelia, and she said Wendy had lost weight since the last time and was very weak. She said if they took her into surgery, she could die there. They took an x-ray to see what it could be (they took her away and didn't bring her back so I could say goodbye), and they found a gallstone. She had to be admitted to stabilize her, but supposedly, according to Noelia, there was no danger and surgery wasn't necessary or urgent because she DIDN'T HAVE ANYTHING SERIOUS. The next day at 9 a.m., she called me to tell me Wendy had died, without explanation, without a reason. They said they had woken up in the morning and found her like that, tried to resuscitate her, and couldn't. Not content with this, I didn't have the strength to go see her dead, so I asked them to take her to me. They cremated her. This was on a Friday. They didn't explain anything to me and just said they would call. Days passed and no one called. On Tuesday, I called them, and they basically told me they still had my Wendy there in the refrigerator because if I didn't pay, they wouldn't take her to be cremated. (Not to mention that I had already paid for all the tests, medications, and nights of hospitalization, which they didn't do because she was too weak, and she didn't stay because she died the first night.) In short, I took my guinea pig to "specialists" (I live in Algemesí and I traveled all the way to Valencia specifically) so she would be well, and all I got was for her to die without even being able to say goodbye. On top of that, she died on April 11th, and I received the ashes on April 23rd and had to go pick them up. Without a doubt, if I have another animal, this is the last vet I would take it to. They only care about money; they don't care about the animals. SHAMEFUL. The funeral home, though, was a joke. 10,000. Fast and everything was lovely. I've seen that they haven't answered me at any point; they never told me she was in critical condition. Liars! If they hadn't, I would have taken her back. If you don't know how to do your job, that's not my damn problem. And on top of that, you don't refund a single penny, you shameless crooks! And regarding the reviews, I'll just say that this isn't the first animal you've let die because you don't even know what's wrong with it. Shameless! And unfortunately, it won't be the last. Liars. Seriously, people, if you don't want your animal to die, don't take it to this clinic. They have no professionalism whatsoever, and on top of that, they try to make people out to be liars. What's more, look how much of a liar they are: they say she died at night and they tried to resuscitate her right away, and when they called me, they told me they had gone IN THE MORNING when they woke up and found her dead. Liars!

We took our cockatiel to the emergency vet because she was very sick.

We are so grateful for the care and attention we received. Noelia took excellent care of us, and our cockatiel is back home with us. Highly recommended.

I'm writing this review to first and foremost thank Miguel, the receptionist, for his excellent telephone service. He was very honest and provided us with all the necessary information about a couple of options before we went to the vet. He was very friendly and helpful.

I'd also like to thank Noelia, the veterinarian, for her high-quality and practical service, demonstrating her professionalism. We know exactly where to go.

I regret not taking my cockatiel to this clinic sooner. It was the second exotic animal clinic I visited, and I was much more impressed.
The vet was very professional and empathetic.
Thank you for trying to save my Rodolfita.

I'm so happy to have found a clinic like this. Professionals through and through. Their love for their work is undeniable. You are a great example to follow. I hope to continue using this clinic for many years to come. Thank you so much for treating us like family. Hugs 🫂 …
Excellent service, very friendly, very considerate, 100% recommended.

I took my lovebird to the emergency vet because he was very ill. At first, they told me it could be hormonal, but after further tests, they found his stomach was inflamed, possibly due to bacteria. Even so, they only gave him an anti-inflammatory and told me to wait a week. No one warned me about the seriousness of the situation or that the diagnosis could have such a tragic outcome. My bird died at home the second night.

Furthermore, when I called to cancel the appointment and explained what had happened, they simply told me the appointment was already canceled and that they could arrange the cremation if I wanted. Not a word of condolence. I felt completely indifferent, as if my little one's life didn't matter. Goodbye, Lia 🤍

Amazing vet. I was shocked when my rat started feeling bad in the late evening. I started to search for 24h urgency and these amazing professionals gave me full phone consultation including diagnosis (which seems to be a pure miracle without seeing a rat). We rushed to the clinic the next day and  got the best service I ever had in a vet. X-ray, shot of the medicine and full consultation in fluent English by our gorgeous doctor Javier. I’m extremely grateful to the whole team of this fantastic clinic for describing me every single detail about my boy’s condition, being patient and kind. True professionals. We’ve already had several visits to this clinic and I would highly recommend it. By the way, prices are great. Absolutely affordable.

The whole team is fantastic. I wouldn't give them more stars because there aren't enough. But they've made me feel a little bit happier again by helping me get my beloved Gothi back. I recommend them 100%.
I am always completely grateful for Noelia's attention, professionalism, and care, always with my hamsters.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to Laura, who has treated our Sherlock and us wonderfully from the very beginning. We are still undergoing treatment, but it's only fair to say that her commitment and dedication are total, and her patience with us is immense, answering our many questions.
Thank you so much because we know we are in good hands and feel very supported throughout the process.

Hugs

Rating: ★☆☆☆☆ (1 star) - Incomplete diagnosis, negligence, and lack of professionalism

I do not recommend this exotic pet clinic. I took my parakeet in because she was sneezing constantly (more than 20 times a day) and lethargy. My experience was terrible and frustrating:

1. Information ignored: I clearly stated my suspicion of respiratory mites due to the sneezing. This information was completely ignored, and no tests were performed to rule it out.

2. Incomplete diagnosis: Although tests were done (x-ray and fecal analysis), the focus was solely on a secondary bacterial infection. The x-ray showed an abnormally small intestinal tract, a crucial finding that was not explained as an underlying condition.

3. Inadequate initial treatment: The first antibiotic prescribed (Flagyl) caused her to vomit repeatedly. When I reported this problem, the response was not urgent enough, leaving my pet without effective treatment for a critical period.

4. Lack of professionalism and transparency: On Monday, I requested in writing that the medical data (x-ray and report) be sent. They assured me they would send it on Wednesday. Today is Saturday, and I am still waiting, with no explanation or communication from them. This is unacceptable.

My pet's improvement is solely due to my own research and persistence, not to a thorough diagnosis by the clinic. They didn't act as allies in my pet's health, but rather as another obstacle to overcome. I strongly advise against this clinic if you are looking for professionalism, communication, and a rigorous diagnosis for your exotic animal.

Hi, I'm Sami, a cute little guinea pig, and I'd like to thank my vet, Eli, for everything she's done for me. She's treating my illness with so much love and care, and she's a true professional. She knows a ton and is super nice, just like the whole team at Clínica Nido. Sniff, sniff!

I took my hamster to the clinic in agony, suffering and fighting for her life, and the clinic that claimed to offer "24-hour emergency" care was closed, leaving us completely helpless and waiting to find her lifeless tomorrow, horrified to see her suffer.
The medicine they prescribed not only didn't help, but it made everything worse, and 90 euros were wasted. My little one ended up suffering more than necessary due to the negligence and incompetence of this place.
It's completely irresponsible to charge for services that don't even meet the basics, especially when it comes to fragile and precious lives like those of our pets.
I will never go back, and I don't recommend this clinic to anyone who wants real, fast, and compassionate care.
If your pet is ever in an emergency, don't trust them, because they could leave you in the same agony I experienced. And the person in charge who treated me is named Nelo.

I want to sincerely thank Nido Veterinary Clinic, one of the few in Valencia specializing in exotic animals, and especially veterinarians Nelo and Noe, for the care and excellent attention they have always given my guinea pig.

In the most difficult moments, and also in the simplest, we have always felt reassured that nothing more or better could be done.
The entire team exudes professionalism, warmth, and genuine dedication that make you feel you're in the best hands. How lucky I was to find you.
Thank you so much. 💚

I have nothing but words of gratitude for you all. Not only for the exceptional treatment we received, both for me and my baby Trunks, who arrived with a jaw abscess that became increasingly complicated. Eli, I don't know how to thank you enough for what you've done for us, despite the unexpected challenges, including a CT scan two weeks prior that was no longer useful. Your ability to improvise and react to all these problems, your efficiency, your sincerity, the way you explained things to me, and how you cared for my boy these past five days... I am truly grateful. And so is Trunks.

Eli, Javi, Noe... You are a wonderful team.

I am so grateful to the amazing team at Clínica Nido.

A special thank you to Javi for saving Kobi, treating him with such care from the very first moment, and giving us peace of mind, confidence, and security. We brought our guinea pig in on the recommendation of another clinic, and with a pretty poor prognosis, it's been a long road with many visits, but without a doubt, it was the best decision because the effort has been worth it, and our guinea pig is now super active and full of energy.
You have completely earned our trust with your impeccable work and dedication. Thank you so much ❤️‍🩹✨

I have nothing but praise for each and every person who works at this clinic, and especially for Eli.

I have two ferrets named Nova and Milky. Milky passed away in December due to health problems he'd had since he was a kitten, and all these years the care he received was incredible. He underwent countless tests to find the best solution for his problems, many consultations, and trips to other centers for tests with better equipment. Eli always treated him with the utmost care, not only towards me but especially towards him.

Yes, it was a lot of money over the years, but my situation was always understood, and the best option for everyone was considered. Furthermore, both he and Nova were visitors in the emergency room, and everyone else who treated them was truly wonderful: Nelo, Noe, Miguel, Laura, Javi... I've had bad experiences at other clinics, and I've never seen one that cares so much about the animals' well-being and has so much patience. I will never tire of recommending this place, and I will certainly continue to go there with Nova and any other animals I may have in the future.

My pyrrhura is hospitalized due to ingestion of small metals, and so far I'm happy with the care and explanations they give to the owners. I don't know if it will survive, but I want to think so. It's being admitted again tonight 🤞 Let's see if it pulls through. It's so tiny! …

My daughter's rabbit, Misu, whom I was looking after, got very sick. I called them Saturday night and spoke with Javi, who listened to everything and reassured me that I could call back later that night or the next day if I thought we should go. I called again on Sunday, as Misu hadn't improved, so we went with him. Javi was always there to help. Naturally, I paid for an emergency consultation, since it was Sunday, and thank goodness he saw him. He did what was necessary, but only if I wanted him to. He explained everything to us, and we were able to take him home with treatment, as it was cardiac arrest, which is very serious in rabbits. Fortunately, Misu has recovered. I have the full report, and I think he was excellent. I highly recommend him.

I want to thank the Nido clinic and especially Elisabet, who did everything possible to help Tifon pull through. He was very ill, but they tried everything they could to save him, which unfortunately wasn't possible... Thank you for giving your all for Tifon... We will always be grateful. All the best to you.

We needed an emergency vet on a Sunday and found this clinic. We took our parrot Aruca in and were lucky enough to find Laura, who was affectionate with the little one, empathetic with us, and, above all, a fantastic professional.
It's a shame we don't live here so we could make her our vet. Thank you!

I've been going to this clinic with my pets for years. They transferred one of my rats because she had better treatment options, and it was the best thing that could have happened. Rats are delicate animals, and I've had to go countless times. Every single time, I've felt comfortable, confident, and safe. You can tell the whole team puts so much love into what they do, that they genuinely care and don't just treat your pet like a customer. They get involved and treat your animal with the utmost empathy. Even in her old age and in an extremely delicate and difficult-to-treat state, they always offered everything they could and exhausted all available resources. I will always be eternally grateful that in the last stage of her life, in her final days there, I know she was cared for and happy, and that they gave me precious extra time with her so we could spend more time together. I've almost always had Javi as my vet, and he's always been an absolute sweetheart—so sensitive and professional. Even during such difficult and delicate times, he made me feel safe, comfortable, and supported, assuring me that everything possible was being done. I've also had Noe and Laura as vets at other times, and I can say the same about them and the whole team. They're all lovely and incredibly kind, and I have complete faith in their professional judgment. I still go there with my pigeon and all the other little critters I come across, and I have absolutely no complaints.

P.S. Juanita sends you pigeon kisses 💗

I think this is the worst veterinary clinic I've been to. Unprofessional treatment of my rat, who died a couple of days ago. No one could even tell me that she was already in a critical condition and urgently needed injections to maintain life, as well as emergency treatment. They don't even understand what to feed rats. I regretted that I went to this clinic. I don't recommend it.

We took our pigeons (rescued and adopted because they couldn't be released due to their disabilities) and Javi looked after us. He explained everything calmly, listened to our questions, and carefully considered all the options based on our specific situation. He was very professional and kind. I'm leaving feeling incredibly happy and at ease with the care we received ❤️🕊️

I do not recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone.

The staff is completely unprofessional.

They told me my parrot was perfectly fine, but another veterinary clinic diagnosed him with a serious fungal infection.

Fortunately, I didn't trust their diagnosis and sought a second opinion, as my parrot was in very poor condition.

Under no circumstances should you take your pet to this clinic.

We found an injured pigeon in Valencia and took it there. The woman, whose name I think is Eli, was lovely and incredibly professional. We need more veterinary centers like this in Valencia because nobody wants pigeons, not even the bird recovery center. So we're so grateful that no animal is discarded simply because of its species. We're following the treatment closely and hope it works and saves a life—a life is a life.

I honestly don't even know where to begin… We moved and had to switch to this clinic because of its proximity and a recommendation.
The first time we took him, it started badly because of a vet who spoke to us terribly and made us feel awful, but we gave them a chance since we were nearby and they specialized in exotic animals. The first filing, then the following month we went back for the same thing, and less than two months later, again. Well, in less than six months, I think we went four times for the same issue.
Obviously, we decided to go back to our usual clinic because it didn't seem normal to be going so frequently.
When we arrived at our usual vet's, he told us that he had deformities in several teeth and that some were growing downwards, which would cause a jaw fracture and inflammation with pus, potentially leading to his death.

When we were at Nido, the issue of downward growth was never mentioned to us. They actually told us they could remove cells from one or two teeth, but not more than four, as is the case here…

In conclusion, the animal suffered from sedation and so many visits to the clinic, received poor treatment (except from two staff members), had only superficial filing (to encourage more frequent visits and, obviously, spend more money), and the prognosis was poor or hidden.

We will not return, nor will we recommend them.

Thank you so much for all your help!

Last night I had an emergency with a hedgehog, and unfortunately, I can't remember the vet's name. I wanted to say thank you for your help and for being so kind ❤️ Great professionals with heart!

My Pixie guinea pig was hospitalized for a week with severe diarrhea. They sent her back to me saying she had a bit of a sluggishness because she was five and a half years old, but that she was eating on her own and they had stopped the diarrhea... A LIE!!! THAT SAME NIGHT SHE WAS STILL THE SAME... I took her back the next day and had her admitted again. Blood tests, ultrasounds, they removed a small stone from her urethra... they sent her back and she was still the same. After spending 1000 euros, they tell me she might have ovarian cysts and they have to remove them for analysis... but she still had diarrhea, was losing weight, and... questionable professionalism, Javi. I mean, you haven't got a clue. She died of gastrointestinal arrest. You should open a kiosk and sell sunflower seeds and see if you're better at that. You'll have to tell me what you were doing for 11 days, returning my guinea pig to me in worse condition than before... Lots of blah blah blah and no definitive results, so let that weigh on your conscience, if you even have one. She died today. I just hope someone reads this and thinks twice before leaving their pet in your hands. And since you had the nerve to reply, I'll edit this: first you told me it was cystitis, then something I had at home that was upsetting her, then the tap water... The sterilization thing was only mentioned on the last day when I took her out of there, because you didn't know what to do and even then you didn't give me any hope. If you had told me the first day what you're now so adamantly stating, she would have been operated on, but you know that wasn't the case. In fact, Mr. Javi was asking me how I kept them at home because I couldn't explain it. I showed him photos and videos of the cage, so don't make excuses now and check the receipts from the two times she was there. But don't worry, we won't see each other again.
Never again, I would NEVER recommend this clinic. Too much pain to forget.

Our experience at Nido has been wonderful. They were with us every step of the way and did everything they could for Corki and Teemo. I want to thank everyone, but especially Noelia. You've been a light during this difficult time for us, giving us hope when we had it, and being honest when we needed to be. You're a true professional because you know your job and you're incredibly empathetic. I understand that it must be tough to support someone through this process, and that's why I'll be forever grateful to you. We need more professionals like you. Thank you for the time you dedicated to my little ones and to us.

After almost a year, I've finally decided to write and recount what happened. I took my two birds to this clinic (they were two 10-day-old hand-raised chicks). A veterinarian, whose name I don't remember, gave them both an injection, supposedly vitamins, and from then on, both birds started having serious problems:

One of my birds had a huge wound right where he was injected, and the other suffered crop failure…

I took the one with the crop failure to the emergency vet two or three times (the budgie). At first, they didn't do anything; they gave him some medication that was supposed to stimulate digestion. Then, at the last emergency appointments, they admitted the budgie, even though I didn't want him to be; they said it was for the best. They said they would call back, but they didn't. Finally, when I managed to get in touch with them, they told me the procedure had gone well, that they had been able to remove all the contents of his crop, and that he was very lively. A few minutes later, they called me and told me the parakeet had fainted. Then I called them to find out how he was because they hadn't told me anything, and they told me he had died. I had to call them myself because they hadn't even bothered to call; I had to call and ask about the parakeet so they could give me some information, since they hadn't bothered to call me to let me know anything.

On the other hand, with my other little bird, who also had a wound that I'm sure was caused by the injection, they told me they couldn't do anything for him. They said the emergency consultation was €90, but that he was doomed to die... I didn't take him there. I waited and took him to another vet, and luckily, this vet saved his life. Meanwhile, at Clínica Nido, they just kept telling me he was going to die without even examining the animal. So I'm giving you one star because I have no other option but to give you zero.

This whole situation is deplorable.
Eli, Miguel; Thank you. Always ❤️❤️🐼 …
Dr. Nelo was very professional and empathetic in helping a bird we brought in today. He also gave a clear and direct explanation of the condition. Thank you.

Finally, after months of going from one vet to another looking for a solution for my kiwi ferret, this clinic treated me with exceptional kindness, explained everything very well, and was very attentive. The care my ferret received was wonderful. I will definitely go back to them whenever I have any problems. Thank you so much for your attention! ❣️

A truly disappointing experience.

We called at 8:15 pm to let them know our pet had suffered a severe attack and that we were on our way, having been recommended by a local veterinary clinic that specialized in this type of animal.

The receptionist informed us that they were already operating on an emergency schedule (90€ for the consultation alone), but we insisted that we were on our way (60 km), to which she replied that we had to call the emergency number. What number, girl? Didn't I already warn you? Besides, if you want me to call another number, at least tell me what it is.

We arrived in a rush at 8:55 pm, and the "sweet" welcome we received, both from the receptionist, who was curt and bordered on unfriendly, and from the veterinarian, was a clear sign of annoyance at our unannounced arrival, as they were closing and she was leaving, requiring another colleague to come in. Anyway.

Regarding the animal, an X-ray was taken, and we received a very serious diagnosis (death within days), more concise than the one provided by ChatGPT. We decided against euthanasia and wanted to care for him as long as he lived. The only suggestion they made was to keep him under observation at the clinic for a few days, with no guarantees whatsoever. If the situation seems irreversible, why leave him there? To further inflate the bill? At no point did they advise us on how we could care for him at home, nor on his diet, positioning, antibiotics, or anything else, despite our concern for his well-being.

After making the enormous effort to see us for just over 10 minutes, they sent us home with the animal abandoned to its fate, leaving us demoralized. However, we were €150 cheaper.

I sensed too much profit-driven motive and too little concern for the animals' health, so I will not be returning.

This review is to thank everyone at Nido for the care our bunny Canela received. All the veterinarians (Nelo, Eli, Noelia, Javi, Laura...) treated us with such compassion during such a delicate time as her peritonitis surgery and post-operative period. They allowed us to be with our bunny at all times and we were able to say goodbye. Thank you.
A good clinic, with professional vets!
I'm super happy with the service I received!

I took my little rat, Pimienta, to the emergency room today, Sunday, April 20th. She's very old and in very serious condition. We decided to have her euthanized to prevent further suffering. It was as hard as when her sister passed away just a month ago. We arrived mid-afternoon, and the vet on duty (I forgot to ask her name) treated us with incredible tact and professionalism. She gave us the best advice based on the situation and dedicated all the time we needed. I'm writing this review mainly hoping it reaches her somehow and that she knows how incredibly grateful we are. We hope all your other patients feel just as satisfied because I guarantee the effort is worthwhile <3.
I am very grateful for having extended Kika's life as much as possible.

It's an excellent clinic. The care is unbeatable.

Laura and Noe did everything and more for my little Pipa, a Russian hamster. They supported us through a process that was incredibly difficult for me, always with great sensitivity, but without losing sight of reality. When there was nothing more that could be done, I felt incredibly supported.

I miss my little mouse terribly, but I know that both I and the staff at this clinic did everything possible for her well-being. I have peace of mind knowing that she lived and passed away like a queen, with dignity.

Not every professional is like the people who work at Nido. Laura, Noe, thank you so much. I am eternally grateful. You are the best, and while I hope that not many cases end up like mine, I hope that many little ones find you, because they all deserve such wonderful care ❤️

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. It's been almost two years since they operated on my gerbil, Pimienta, and we never once doubted them. The staff is incredibly friendly, explaining everything in detail and being incredibly kind.
When her sister, Sal, passed away, they were there to support us and offer advice, which we greatly appreciated.
Plus, the price is very affordable.

We've been going to this clinic for so many years, and when we needed them most, they abandoned us during the DANA storm. We lost our 10-year-old bunny over something trivial that they could have helped us with instead of stalling. I'm very disappointed in them; I didn't expect this.
Excellent service and very friendly staff, both Javier, who we consulted with for our initial consultation, and Noelia, who helped us when we had a problem with Raptor! Thank you! 🫶🏻 …

I've taken my gerbils here, may they rest in peace, as well as my guinea pig Pumba, who passed away some time ago, and my bunny Kylo, ​​who died at this clinic on Friday, March 14th.

I want to state in this review that although my little Kylo died from a post-operative complication while still hospitalized, as someone who keeps small mammals, I am perfectly aware that they are (unfortunately for us) very fragile and any change in their system can, sadly, mean death. Far from thinking ill of the excellent professionals who have always been at this clinic, I want to thank them for the great work they do, and especially for the sensitivity they showed in the face of my little Kylo's sudden death, and for how well they monitored my bunny's paw before she went into surgery and until that fateful moment passed. Special thanks to Eli, the veterinarian who handled the case, who even repeatedly apologized afterward for calling me when Kylo came out of surgery, because they hadn't yet been able to properly assess how his body reacted to the anesthesia, even though it was a possibility they had already mentioned to me.
If I ever have another exotic or small animal, I would come back here without hesitation.

Words cannot express our gratitude and admiration for the wonderful team of people at this clinic. As professionals, they are truly outstanding, but what truly matters most is their enormous heart and dedication to all their patients, and the tremendous help and support they offer to those of us who accompany them.
You are incredible!
Thank you so much for all your care and dedication!

We are very happy with the professional and caring treatment our pets receive.

We have a Lop rabbit who is incredibly healthy thanks to them, even though she had many health problems as a baby.

We later adopted her companion (another Lop rabbit) and he is also super healthy thanks to the excellent work at Clínica Nido.

They are very thorough with disease prevention (vaccinations, deworming, etc.).

We also had our rabbit spayed here, and the operation was a complete success.

Special thanks to Eli and Noe for their great professionalism and kindness.

Keep up the good work! 👏💪

I brought in a dove I've been caring for for quite some time. They simply plucked some feathers and put a bandage on it. I'd already been caring for it for a while since rescuing it. The cost was 30 Euros. I asked for a summary of the visit, including details (sex, weight, age, etc., and whether it was attacked by an animal or had its feathers cut). It seems they didn't write much down. Regarding the procedure, they said it might end up the same or worse, but despite having a problem due to a deformity from the nest (it's a young adult, probably less than a year old, but certainly not a fledgling), they said it needs surgery as soon as possible. I asked for the details, and they said they had to write them up properly and would send them in the afternoon. They forgot, and this morning they didn't answer the phone (they hung up), and at midday, when I called again, it seemed they'd been in the operating room the whole time. It doesn't matter; I need its medical history and file to at least assess whether I should continue caring for the dove here. 30 euros is more than just bandaging and plucking feathers without pain relief in a short time. X-rays cost 70 euros, including a visit, and the procedure itself cost 150 euros. I don't trust them, especially since there were trainees and very young staff in general. Once I have the results of their work, I'll consider taking her somewhere else, but paying implies you expect some professionalism. Of course, the data can be claimed under data protection laws. They explained that she has to keep the bandage on until the operation and change it if it gets dirty... On another occasion, a long time ago, I took one that required attention, and they gave her a lethal injection, and that was it.

(Edit) I finally received the report I requested by email. Since I didn't receive it yesterday afternoon as agreed upon yesterday morning in a phone call, it seems it wasn't ready. It states that even with surgery, the chances of fixing the leg are slim to none. That's enough for me, and it's what I wanted to know, along with her age and some other details. There must be avian physiotherapists; I'll take this to them or get an X-ray, but I'm not in a rush. They recommended waiting two weeks, which surprised me since it was a nest injury. They ruled out splay legs, which is what I thought when I rescued her; I was also interested in knowing that.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the entire team at Clínica Nido, especially Javier and Noelia. The team demonstrated in-depth knowledge, explaining the recommended treatment to me in detail. Thanks to them, my little Pichi, a one-and-a-half-year-old lovebird, is back to her old self and, most importantly, super active again. I wholeheartedly recommend this exotic animal clinic in Valencia; they are highly professional and offer specialized care. Thank you! ♥️
Very good clinic. The doctors know English. I got a good service and consultation.

After months of deliberating whether or not to write this review, today, with a heavy heart, I've finally decided to do it. We took a rabbit named Hermes, just over six months old and in perfect health (he'd never had any problems whatsoever; we'd even taken him on a long car trip and he never showed any signs of nervousness or anxiety), to get his vaccinations because it was due for a booster. A veterinarian named Noe attended to us; she was very tactful, and I must say, she was very kind and attentive at first. We vaccinated Hermes and took him home. Three days after the vaccination, he went into digestive arrest, so we took him to the emergency vet, where he was admitted. They told us they would call us to update us on his progress, and we spent 24 hours nervous and terrified, glued to our phones. The day after he was admitted, they told us we could take him home, even though he hadn't defecated yet, although he had eaten. The vet suggested he might be uncomfortable, which was why he hadn't defecated. We took him home. Hermes was more lethargic, barely drinking water and eating very little. A few days later, he stopped eating again, and we knew immediately that he either had another episode of respiratory arrest or had never fully recovered from the previous one. We called the clinic, and the vet told us "it might be nothing and we should wait." Obviously, I refused, and we took him back. Hermes was readmitted. We didn't hear anything about him for practically a whole day. We called and called, and the receptionist, in a very rude, impolite tone and with an ENORMOUS lack of tact, told us to just put up with it, that there were other patients. We kept insisting; Hermes was our baby, and we NEEDED to know how he was. It was practically two days after his second admission, after I'd given them a huge dressing-down on the phone, that I finally got through to his vet, Noe. When I asked her exactly what Hermes's condition was, she told me that while a digestive arrest was serious, he wasn't in critical condition, nor did she think he was going to die, and that if they had to operate to empty his stomach, they would call us BEFORE doing so. Later, I called again, and another vet, whose name I don't know, assured me that Hermes was stable. That morning, Hermes went into surgery, and do you know who got the call? NO ONE. In the morning, Nelo called me to tell me that Hermes was very ill, that they had emptied his stomach, and that he was probably going to die, and that's exactly what happened. We took a healthy rabbit in, and in less than a week, they killed him. Nelo told us they would give us a report to find out exactly what had happened. Have you seen that report? Because none of us did either. It never arrived.

This veterinary clinic not only lacks tact and empathy, but they also see animals as nothing more than merchandise. And above all, you should change the way your receptionist treats people who are suffering because of their pets. It's a real disgrace.

My advice? Never go near this place. They weren't in any hurry to call me about Hermes's condition, but they were quick to charge me even though they had killed my rabbit.
My rabbit died and they took advantage of the situation to keep the carrier without asking, vultures.

Thank you for taking care of Charlie, I am very grateful for everything you have done for him! You are the best professionals, you have an unsurpassed human quality! Eli, Nelo, Miguel, Mapi, Noelia, Laura, Javi Thank you all so much💋💋💋😍😍😍 your "little gruñoncete" will always be grateful to you 🐰❤️🌈 …

Thanks to Nelo, our cockatiel Nevis is now 12 years old and has overcome a serious stomach illness thanks to his professionalism and care. We continue to take her for all her checkups, and they are lovely and very professional.
They are very professional!

They were incredibly helpful over the phone, as the clinic isn't very close and I couldn't get there in person. I had a problem with my baby lovebirds, and they were very kind in guiding me through the necessary steps, as it was a potential emergency. They did all this without any intention of making a profit, which I truly appreciate. If I ever have another problem with my lovebirds, I will definitely keep this veterinary clinic in mind because of their professionalism and kindness.

Thanks to them, our cockatiel Currupipi is still alive!
We had to rush her from Castellón. During one of her flights at home, she crashed and after a short while, she started convulsing. It seemed to be something neurological.
From the moment we called to ask if we could come until they returned her to us, the service was incredibly kind, professional, and empathetic. And most importantly, they saved our cockatiel's life.
Javier was the vet who treated her. Very professional! Currupipi was quite ill. He explained everything very well, told us the treatment plan, and admitted her. He called us the next day. She was much better; he was even surprised! Even so, it was best to keep her under observation. We waited another day and were finally able to pick her up. Noelia handed her over to us! She was incredibly caring, kind, and also very professional! Giving us advice and guidelines. Now, after a few days, we've spoken to Javier again to tell him how Currupipi is doing!
She's doing great! As if nothing had happened! We are so grateful to the whole team! It's been such a wonderful discovery to find you all!
I'm delighted with Nelo and his entire team for being so kind and professional with my guinea pig. Thank you so much!

Today, December 14, 2024, we had to take our pigeon, Manuel, to the clinic for an emergency. We couldn't have been happier. It's difficult to find vets on a Saturday at 2 pm, and even more so for exotic animals like pigeons, but they saw us quickly and without any problems. The vet was a true professional, explaining everything very well and calmly during such a difficult time. We've definitely found a trusted vet for Manuel now. I recommend that everyone bring their pets. Thank you so much! 🥹✨️❤️‍🩹

Last night, December 8th, we had an emergency with our lovebird, Pavarotti, and after a long search, we found Clínica Nido. We had tried contacting other clinics, but we couldn't get the help we needed until we came here.

From the very first moment, the veterinarian who saw us gave us enormous peace of mind. She was kind, professional, and treated Pavarotti with incredible care. On a night filled with anxiety, finding someone who took the time to explain everything and take such good care of our little one was a huge relief.

Without a doubt, Clínica Nido has earned our trust, and we've already made it our go-to clinic for our furry friends: Paco the African Grey parrot, Ares the guinea pig, and Pavarotti the lovebird. We'll definitely be back if any of them need it!

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for everything you do. You're amazing. 🐦🐹❤️

I can definitely recommend this place. I was fortunate enough to have Noelia attend to my little one in the middle of the night for an emergency. She stabilized her and gave her excellent care. I am grateful to the entire Nido team. I highly recommend them; they do their work with love, and it shows!

A wonderful clinic thanks to its specialists.
Noelia saw me in the emergency room, and then Javier.
Both were very professional and, above all, very caring with the animals and with the people who were suffering because of our pets. I recommend it 100%.
I went there for an emergency, and even though it was late, they treated my little one very well and allowed me to say goodbye to her in the best way possible. Thank you so much!

Our trusted clinic. The first time we took our bunnies for a checkup, they treated us wonderfully, with time and dedication.
Our trust grew, and we are incredibly grateful to the entire team who saved the life of one of our little ones after a liver torsion.
We recommend the clinic for everything, from routine checkups to critical cases. Thank you so much!
Yesterday we went with my bearded dragon, the service was efficient and very professional. The facilities were very clean. Thank you!

I found a pigeon in the street with a broken wing, and I'm absolutely delighted with the care it received from the veterinarian, Nelo. He was incredibly kind and friendly to both me and the animal, and he handled the case with the utmost professionalism. It's clear he's very knowledgeable. He was also very reasonable with his prices.

I also want to mention that the assistant who helped me was incredibly kind. I'm very happy with the clinic.

The veterinarian who treated my pet had to see her several times, the first time as an emergency; they saw me right away. She was clear with me and gentle with the animal. The treatment was excellent.
They are wonderful with animals.
Noelia and her colleagues provided excellent service. It's clear that they care about every animal. We need more professionals like them.

Yesterday, Javier, a charming and very professional young man, attended to us. We recently adopted a lovebird and noticed something wasn't quite right. He advised and informed us about its care and feeding guidelines. He examined and …
I love the place and the service; the girls are super friendly and you can tell they love their work ❤️❤️ I will definitely come back again.
Great professionals! I took my lovebird in with a wing problem and they fixed it wonderfully. They told me it probably wouldn't fly, but it hasn't stopped flying since, thanks to Nelo! …

It had been a long time since I'd dealt with a bird clinic that treated animals with the dignity they deserve and the care we animal lovers need. Javi took me in for an emergency visit to treat Pipo, who was in critical condition. They did …
Very professional.

My whole family, and especially Obelina, want to congratulate you on your work, particularly Nelo. First and foremost, as a person, a truly human being, with a strong vocation, working tirelessly every day for the best care and health of …
